facts.value: Updates the animation and collision lifecycle of Yorster's nine responsive elements. It prioritizes accumulated attack input over current-update vertical impact, computes a starting animation offset, delays collision removal, and later restores animation, material handling and collision when timer and spatial guards permit. Obstructed restoration uses a separate retry state; every element update clears the vertical-impact accumulator.

facts.value: For each of nine records, switch on the state byte cast to s8. States 0 and 1 first test x04 against parameter x08; only otherwise do they test x08 against parameter x00. Either trigger disables material handling, computes x10 from a threshold remainder and the lesser of configured and actual animation end frames, loads x0C from parameter x18, and sets state 2. The impact branch additionally clamps its post-subtraction contribution to at least parameter x00 and calls Ground_801C53EC(0xE). State 2 decrements a positive x0C; when already nonpositive it starts selector-7 animation 0 at x10, removes the collision joint, sets state 3 and seeds x0C from x10. State 3 increments x0C below 0x143. At or above 0x143, a true grLib_801C9EE8 result at radius 10*Ground_801C0498()-2 starts animation 2 at rate 0.3, resets x0C and enters state 4; a false result restores directly and emits the end-frame diagnostic. State 4 checks grAnime_801C84A4 != 0 or x0C >= 0x19. When either holds, it resets x0C before testing radius (10*Ground_801C0498())/2 and restores only if grLib_801C9EE8 is false; otherwise it remains in state 4. If neither guard holds, x0C increments. Both restoration paths start animation 1, re-add collision, reenable material handling, clear x04 and x08, and set state 1. Independently of the selected or default state, x08 is cleared at the end of every element iteration. The numeric timer thresholds are not reads of an animation-frame counter.
